stylomastoid_foramen.method: visual pick on CT: lower end of the facial canal (small bony ring at about x 44, y 63 on axial z 258, correctly oriented crops) where it opens on the inferior temporal-bone surface, posterior to the styloid base and anteromedial to the mastoid; consistent with coronal and sagittal cuts

styloid_base.method: visual pick on sagittal CT x=40: upper end of the styloid process

styloid_tip.method: visual pick on sagittal CT x=40: lower end of the styloid process (about 21 mm long)

mastoid_tip_visual.method: visual pick on coronal CT y=62: inferior end of the mastoid process

tympanomastoid_dropoff.method: visual estimate: medial (drop-off) end of the tympanomastoid fissure on the inferior temporal bone surface, between the tympanic plate below the EAC and the anterior mastoid; the fissure itself is not resolved at this CT resolution

digastric_origin.method: estimate: mastoid notch, medial to the mastoid tip; the posterior belly is not segmented (ADR-0002)

tragal_pointer.method: estimate: medial tip of the tragal (conchal) cartilage at the anteroinferior cartilaginous canal, about 7 mm medial of the canal opening; cartilage is not resolved on this CT
